features.name: Bountiful Luck
features.flavor: A halfling's lucky charm protects allies at a crucial moment. Perfect for support-focused halflings who want to help the party.

effects.note: You have a few lucky charms. When you make an ability check, a saving throw or an attack roll, you can reroll the die and use either roll. At 5th level, you can also reroll a d20 result for a death saving throw, and at 13th level, you gain a benefit of your choice.

features.summary: Reroll any ability check, save or attack roll
features.text: You have a few lucky charms. When you make an ability check, a saving throw, or an attack roll, you can reroll the die and use either roll.

features.name: Crusher
features.flavor: A powerful striker who pushes enemies around and creates openings for allies. Perfect for tanks and battlefield controllers.

effects.note: When you hit a creature with an attack, you can choose to deal an additional 1d10 bludgeoning damage, or choose to force the target to succeed on a Strength saving throw or be knocked prone, or choose to force the target to succeed on a Strength saving throw or be pushed 5 feet away. You can use this bonus only once per turn, after you hit or crit.

features.summary: On a hit: 1d10, or knock prone, or push 5 ft
features.text: When you hit a creature with an attack, you can choose to deal an additional 1d10 bludgeoning damage, or choose to force the target to succeed on a Strength saving throw or be knocked prone, or choose to force the target to succeed on a Strength saving throw or be pushed 5 feet away.

features.name: Dragon Fear
features.flavor: A dragonborn who channels their draconic ancestry into a fearsome roar. Perfect for dragonborn tanks and leaders.

effects.note: As a bonus action you can expend a spell slot and grow temporary hit points equal to 1d4 per spell level for 1 minute. Any dragon within 30 feet of you has disadvantage on saving throws against your spells and special effects while you have these hit points, and it takes half damage from them.

features.summary: BA: temp HP from a slot; dragons fear you while they last
features.text: As a bonus action you can expend a spell slot and grow temporary hit points equal to 1d4 per spell level for 1 minute. Any dragon within 30 feet of you has disadvantage on saving throws against your spells and special effects while you have these hit points, and it takes half damage from them.

features.name: Dragon Hide
features.flavor: A dragonborn whose scales harden into natural armor. Ideal for dragonborn who want to maximize their AC without armor.

effects.note: While you have your Draconic Resilience trait, your dragonborn ancestry effect includes both resistances. When you take damage, you can use your reaction to reduce the damage by 1d10 plus your proficiency bonus, and the reduced amount of damage is then temporarily reduced by 1 for each hit, so you can never have this reaction reduced to 0.

features.summary: Reduce damage by 1d10 plus proficiency, stacking per hit
features.text: When you take damage, you can use your reaction to reduce the damage by 1d10 plus your proficiency bonus. The reduced amount of damage is then temporarily reduced by 1 for each hit, so you can never have this reaction reduced to 0.

features.name: Drow High Magic
features.flavor: A drow who taps into the deepest wells of drow magic, gaining access to powerful spells. For high-elf spellcasters seeking versatility.

effects.note: You know the detect magic cantrip, which you can cast at will, and the darkness and faerie fire spells, each of which you can cast once per long rest without a spell slot. At 17th level, one of these spells is replaced.
At 17th level, one of the two spells is replaced by a spell of your choice from the wizard list, castable once per long rest without a spell slot.

features.summary: Detect magic at will; darkness and faerie fire per long rest
features.text: You know the detect magic cantrip, which you can cast at will, and the darkness and faerie fire spells, each of which you can cast once per long rest without a spell slot.

features.name: Durable
features.flavor: A tough survivor who can shake off damage and heal efficiently. Great for front-line characters who need to stay in the fight.
features.summary: +1 Constitution and +1 hit point at every level
features.text: You gain a +1 bonus to Constitution, and your hit point maximum increases by 1, and by 1 again whenever you gain a level.

features.name: Dwarven Fortitude
features.flavor: A hardy dwarf who shrugs off damage with racial toughness. Perfect for dwarf defenders who want to absorb punishment.

effects.note: You have advantage on saving throws against being poisoned, and resistance to poison damage, and you have advantage on death saving throws. You also have dwarven resilience: resistance to poison damage and immunity to the poisoned condition.

features.summary: Advantage against poison and on death saves
features.text: You have advantage on saving throws against being poisoned, and you have dwarven resilience: resistance to poison damage and immunity to the poisoned condition. You also gain advantage on death saving throws.

features.name: Eldritch Adept
features.flavor: A spellcaster who dips into warlock magic, gaining a pact invocation. Requires spellcasting or pact magic feature.

effects.note: You learn the thaumaturgy cantrip, which you can cast at will, and you have temporary hit points equal to 1d4 plus your Intelligence modifier equal to your proficiency bonus, which refresh at the start of a long rest.

features.summary: Thaumaturgy at will, and temp HP equal to your proficiency bonus
features.text: You learn the thaumaturgy cantrip, which you can cast at will, and you have temporary hit points equal to 1d4 plus your Intelligence modifier equal to your proficiency bonus.

features.name: Elemental Adept
features.flavor: A spellcaster who masters a specific element, making their spells harder to resist. Perfect for specialized elemental casters.

effects.note: Choose a damage type: acid, cold, fire, lightning or thunder. When you damage a creature with that type with a spell, you can make the creature's saving throw against the spell as a disadvantage. At 17th level, you gain the same benefit for a second damage type.
You gain the same benefit for a second damage type of your choice.

features.summary: Chosen damage type forces disadvantage on its saves
features.text: When you damage a creature with a spell of a damage type you have chosen, the creature's saving throw against that spell is at a disadvantage.

features.name: Fade Away
features.flavor: A gnome who can vanish from sight when threatened. Perfect for gnome tricksters and spellcasters who need to escape.

effects.note: When you take damage, you can use your reaction to become invisible until the end of your next turn, and any creature within 30 feet of you that can see you also has disadvantage on attack rolls against you until the end of your next turn. The invisibility ends if you attack or cast a spell.

features.summary: Reaction: turn invisible and give nearby attackers disadvantage
features.text: When you take damage, you can use your reaction to become invisible until the end of your next turn, and any creature within 30 feet of you that can see you also has disadvantage on attack rolls against you until the end of your next turn.

features.name: Fell Thrower
features.flavor: A brutal combatant who hurls weapons with deadly force. Ideal for barbarians and fighters who want to throw things.

effects.note: When a creature within 30 feet of you drops to 0 hit points or fails a saving throw to avoid being thrown, you can use your reaction to make a melee weapon attack against it. On a hit, it takes bludgeoning damage equal to 1d6 plus your Strength modifier.

features.summary: Reaction: a bonus attack on something that drops or fails a save
features.text: When a creature within 30 feet of you drops to 0 hit points, or fails a saving throw to avoid being thrown, you can use your reaction to make a melee weapon attack against it.

features.name: Fey Teleportation
features.flavor: An elf or similar fey-touched race who can teleport short distances. Perfect for mobile spellcasters and skirmishers.

effects.note: As a bonus action you can teleport yourself up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space that you can see. At 17th level, you can bring one willing creature within 10 feet of you with you. You gain the use of this once per day and regain it at dawn.
You can bring one willing creature within 10 feet of you with you.

features.summary: Once a day, teleport 30 ft; bring a willing creature at 17
features.text: As a bonus action you can teleport yourself up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space that you can see. You gain the use of this once per day.

features.name: Fey Touched
features.flavor: A character touched by fey magic, gaining access to misty step and a divination/enchantment spell. Great for spellcasters.

effects.note: You know the druidcraft cantrip, which you can cast at will. Choose a 1st-level spell from the druid, fey, or wizard spell list; it is always prepared and can be cast without a spell slot once per long rest. At 17th level, that spell is replaced by a 3rd-level spell from the same list.
At 17th level, one of the two spells is replaced by any other spell of a level you can cast from the same list.

features.summary: Druidcraft at will; choose one 1st-level druid/fey/wizard spell, always prepared, once per long rest
features.text: You know the druidcraft cantrip, which you can cast at will. Choose a 1st-level spell from the druid, fey, or wizard spell list; it is always prepared and can be cast without a spell slot once per long rest. At 17th level, that spell is replaced by a 3rd-level spell from the same list.

features.name: Fighting Initiate
features.flavor: A martial character who learns a fighting style from another class. Requires a fighting style feature.

effects.note: You gain a benefit from your choice of fighting style: Defense, Dueling, Great Weapon Fighting, Protection, Two-Weapon Fighting, Archery, Blessed, or Twilight.

features.summary: Gain a fighting style you do not already have
features.text: You gain a benefit from your choice of fighting style: Defense, Dueling, Great Weapon Fighting, Protection, Two-Weapon Fighting, Archery, Blessed, or Twilight.

features.name: Flames of Phlegethos
features.flavor: A tiefling who channels hellfire, adding fire damage and controlling their flames. Perfect for tiefling spellcasters.

effects.note: When you hit a creature with a melee attack, you can impose burning on it. The target must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 2d6 fire damage and 1d6 of it again at the end of each of its turns on a failure, or half as much on a success. The target can end the burning by making a Dexterity saving throw or by being struck by a wind-based spell.

features.summary: On a melee hit: 2d6 fire and 1d6 each turn until it stops
features.text: When you hit a creature with a melee attack, you can impose burning on it. The target must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 2d6 fire damage and 1d6 of it again at the end of each of its turns.

features.name: Grappler
features.flavor: A physical combatant who excels at wrestling and pinning enemies. Great for strength-based grapplers and controllers.

effects.note: When you hit a creature with a melee attack, you can use a bonus action to grapple a creature that is next to you, even if the creature is two sizes larger than you, and you have advantage on attack rolls against a creature that is grappled by you or is being grappled by one of your allies.

features.summary: Grapple as a bonus action; advantage on grappled targets
features.text: When you hit a creature with a melee attack, you can use a bonus action to grapple a creature that is next to you, even if the creature is two sizes larger than you. You have advantage on attack rolls against a creature that is grappled by you.

features.name: Linguist
features.flavor: A polyglot who learns languages and can create codes. Great for diplomats, spies, and scholarly characters.

effects.note: You gain proficiency in four languages of your choice. You can also use the spell to inspire allies, translating for them as you speak.

features.summary: Proficiency in four languages of your choice
features.text: You gain proficiency in four languages of your choice.

features.name: Martial Adept
features.flavor: A tactical fighter who learns battle maneuvers. Perfect for martial characters who want more options in combat.

effects.note: Your Dexterity modifier is increased by 1, and you gain proficiency in the Unarmored Defense fighting style, which gives you +1 AC while wearing no armor and not wielding a shield. You also gain a ba Attack action and can spend 1 ki point to make a Shove attack, a grapple, or take the Dodge action.

features.summary: +1 Dex; Unarmored Defense; a ki-powered BA action
features.text: You gain a +1 bonus to Dexterity, and you gain proficiency in the Unarmored Defense fighting style.

features.name: Metamagic Adept
features.flavor: A spellcaster who learns metamagic options to customize their spells. Requires spellcasting or pact magic feature.

effects.note: You have learned a single metamagic option: Careful, Distant, Empowered, Extended, Heightened, Quickened, Seeking, Subtle, Transmuted or Twinned. You spend sorcery points equal to the option's cost.

features.summary: Learn one Metamagic option
features.text: You have learned a single metamagic option: Careful, Distant, Empowered, Extended, Heightened, Quickened, Seeking, Subtle, Transmuted, or Twinned.

features.name: Piercer
features.flavor: A precise striker who can pierce through armor and deal critical damage more effectively. Great for martial damage dealers.

effects.note: When you hit a creature with a piercing weapon, you can give yourself a +1 bonus to damage rolls against that creature until the end of your next turn. At 13th level, the damage increases to 2 instead of 1, or you can reroll a 1 or 2 on the damage die and use either roll.
2 bonus damage instead of 1, or reroll a 1 or 2 on the damage die and use either roll.

features.summary: On a piercing hit: +1 damage against that creature
features.text: When you hit a creature with a piercing weapon, you can give yourself a +1 bonus to damage rolls against that creature until the end of your next turn.

features.name: Prodigy
features.flavor: A half-elf, half-orc, or human who excels at skills and tools. Perfect for skill-focused characters and explorers.

effects.note: You get one extra attack of any kind you make with a simple or martial weapon. This can be used only once per turn, and it is in addition to your normal number of attacks, whether from Extra Attack or otherwise.

features.summary: One extra attack of any kind, once per turn
features.text: You get one extra attack of any kind you make with a simple or martial weapon. This can be used only once per turn.

features.name: Ritual Caster
features.flavor: A spellcaster who learns ritual spells from another class. Requires Intelligence or Wisdom 13.

effects.note: Choose a class: bard, cleric, druid, sorcerer, warlock, or wizard. You learn two cantrips of your choice from that class's spell list. In addition, choose one 1st-level spell with the ritual tag from that class's spell list. You can cast these spells using your spellcasting ability for this feat. You can also cast any ritual spell that has this spell list; you don't need to have it prepared, but you must expend a spell slot to cast it.

features.summary: Learn two cantrips and one 1st-level ritual spell from a chosen casting class; cast ritual spells from that class's list
features.text: Choose a class: bard, cleric, druid, sorcerer, warlock, or wizard. You learn two cantrips of your choice from that class's spell list. In addition, choose one 1st-level spell with the ritual tag from that class's spell list. You can cast these spells using your spellcasting ability for this feat. You can also cast any ritual spell that has this spell list; you don't need to have it prepared, but you must expend a spell slot to cast it.

features.name: Second Chance
features.flavor: A halfling who can escape danger by teleporting away. Great for halfling rogues and spellcasters.

effects.note: When you fail a saving throw, you can use your reaction to force a reroll of the same die, and you must use the new roll. You gain the use of this after a long rest.

features.summary: Reaction: reroll a failed save
features.text: When you fail a saving throw, you can use your reaction to force a reroll of the same die. You must use the new roll.

features.name: Shadow Touched
features.flavor: A character touched by shadow magic, gaining invisibility and a necromancy/illusion spell. Great for stealthy spellcasters.

effects.note: You know the shadow blade cantrip, which you can cast at will. Choose a 1st-level spell from the necromancy or wizard spell list; it is always prepared and can be cast without a spell slot once per long rest.

features.summary: Shadow blade at will; choose one 1st-level necromancy/wizard spell, always prepared, once per long rest
features.text: You know the shadow blade cantrip, which you can cast at will. Choose a 1st-level spell from the necromancy or wizard spell list; it is always prepared and can be cast without a spell slot once per long rest.

features.name: Telekinetic
features.flavor: A character with telekinetic abilities, gaining mage hand-like powers and shoving capabilities. Perfect for psionic builds.

effects.note: You learn the telekinesis spell, castable without a spell slot once per long rest. A creature you choose must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be moved up to 30 feet in any direction.

features.summary: Telekinesis once a long rest; move a creature 30 ft
features.text: You learn the telekinesis spell, which you can cast without a spell slot once per long rest. A creature you choose must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be moved up to 30 feet in any direction.

features.name: Skill Expert
features.flavor: A versatile character who gains expertise in a skill and learns a new tool or language. Perfect for skill-focused builds.

effects.note: You gain proficiency in any combination of three skills or tools of your choice, and your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check you make that uses one of those skills or tools.

features.summary: Double proficiency on three skills or tools of your choice
features.text: You gain proficiency in any combination of three skills or tools of your choice, and your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check you make that uses one of those skills or tools.

features.name: Wood Elf Magic
features.flavor: A wood elf who learns druid and ranger spells tied to nature. Perfect for wood elf spellcasters and rangers.

effects.note: You know the druidcraft cantrip, which you can cast at will, and the longstrider and pass without trace spells, each of which you can cast once per long rest without a spell slot.

features.summary: Druidcraft at will; longstrider and pass without trace per rest
features.text: You know the druidcraft cantrip, which you can cast at will, and the longstrider and pass without trace spells, each of which you can cast once per long rest without a spell slot.

features.name: Svirfneblin Magic
features.flavor: A svirfneblin who taps into deep gnome magic, gaining invisibility and illusion spells. Perfect for deep gnome spellcasters.

effects.note: You know the detect magic cantrip, which you can cast at will, and the blindness and deafness spells, each of which you can cast once per long rest without a spell slot. At 17th level, one of these spells is replaced.
At 17th level, one of the two spells is replaced by a spell of your choice from the wizard list.

features.summary: Detect magic at will; blindness and deafness per long rest
features.text: You know the detect magic cantrip, which you can cast at will, and the blindness and deafness spells, each of which you can cast once per long rest without a spell slot.
